name: deixic
description: Use your Deixic workspace from ChatGPT and Codex with the six tools Dex uses: tests, controls, frameworks, vendors, risks, policies, evidence, training and evaluation results. Fix failing tests with pull requests.

interface.shortDescription: Your compliance workspace, with Dex's six tools
interface.longDescription: Read what your Deixic workspace shows: failing tests, controls, frameworks, vendors, risks, policies, evidence and training. Ask Dex, Deixic's agent, for answers it verifies against the workspace's records. Request a governed change with a preview; a person approves it in Deixic, never here. Every call runs with the signed-in person's own permissions. Requires a Deixic account.
defaultPrompt: Which Deixic tests are failing now, and which should I fix first?
Ask Dex which evidence requests wait on my approval.
Which organization and workspace is this connection reading?
